assumptions: Sleep logged: 23:35-05:40, ~6.08h — a bit short of the 7-9h target band, one continuous stretch.

09:00 breakfast: 4 Tnuva Emek Light yellow cheese slices (verified reference) + 15 cherry tomatoes (~255g, standard reference). Tomatoes gave the day's first micros — lycopene 6.6mg, vitamin C 35.7mg, folate 38.3mcg DFE.

09:20 multivitamin (Thorne Basic Nutrients 2/Day, 2 caps): micros_sperm_priority raised by the verified supplement-fact values on top of the food-based totals (zinc +15mg, selenium +200mcg, folate +667mcg DFE, vitamin C +250mg, vitamin D +2000IU, vitamin E +16.5mg) — zero kcal/macros.

Lunch logged from description (no photo), time approximated at 13:00: 150g grilled chicken breast + 100g white cabbage salad in lemon sauce (same rate as the 20 Jul cabbage salad) + 300g black lentil salad with red onion, sweet potato and walnuts (corrected from an initial plain-lentils guess — estimated composition ~150g lentils/80g sweet potato/30g red onion/20g walnuts/10g oil dressing) + 1 pickle + 50g grilled onion. Lentil salad is the day's big folate/fiber driver.
status_note: Slept ~6.08h (23:35-05:40) — a bit short of the 7-9h target band. Double espresso at 06:40, breakfast at 09:00 (yellow cheese + cherry tomatoes), multivitamin at 09:20, another espresso at 10:15, and lunch at 13:00 (grilled chicken, cabbage salad, black lentil salad with sweet potato and walnuts, pickle, grilled onion) — caffeine_shots: 3; lentil salad driving folate/fiber well past target.
